parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg or handle part of the pliers, typically made of rubber or a rubber-coated material for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and non-slip surface for the user to hold and apply force when using the pliers.
parts.Movement_description: It moves around the pivot point in coordination with the other handle to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of carbon steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the main structure of the pliers, including the jaws and pivot, allowing the tool to grip, twist, or cut objects.
parts.Movement_description: It acts as the central pivoting structure, enabling the two legs to move symmetrically to open and close the jaws.
